svg.title: workstation-steward: your config repo, watched and kept in step
svg.desc: An illustrative session, looping, in five scenes. A bare steward shows a banner line: one file changed here and one newer commit on GitHub, as of the last fetch, pointing to steward config sync. steward config ends with the repo section: the GitHub repository and branch, the changed policy file, and the newer commit, each with the command that acts on it. steward review fetches the config repo and lists the same items, plus its open pull requests on GitHub, such as Renovate's. After Renovate's pull request is merged, steward config sync shows the plan (one commit, the mise files it changes, the local edit that stays, then mise install and steward check); with --apply it asks, fast-forwards, prints the receipt and the rollback command, runs mise install after a yes, and runs steward check.
